2226-2397-4713.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts.
2226-2397-4713.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-4713.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lumengrid Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Lumengrid Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

147-3890-3899.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-3890-3899.description:
Cast Unearth by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4772-6441-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1643-2073-6797-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

567-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
567-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

4785-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4785-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4785-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1618-4872-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
1618-4872-7757.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing the time counters from Time Warp.
Time Warp's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-2092-4552-7251.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
539-2092-4552-7251.description:
Activate Vindictive Warden by paying {0} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and Blossoming Tortoise (as Vindictive Warden is a land due to Ashaya), dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

2034-4365-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4365-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2459-4053-5231-6989.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1350-2167-2793-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Squandered Resources ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

729-2034-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Great Oak Guardian.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Great Oak Guardian token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2556-4050-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2556-4050-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Mnemonic Wall and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Mnemonic Wall, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1171-4222-5470.manaNeeded: {U} if Freed from the Real is attached to Garth
1171-4222-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Garth does not have summoning sickness.
"Black Lotus" has not been chosen by Garth.
Freed from the Real attached to any nontoken creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
1171-4222-5470.description:
Activate Garth by tapping it, creating a copy of Black Lotus and casting it by paying {0}.
If Freed from the Real is attached to Garth, activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Garth.
Activate Garth by tapping it, creating a copy of the Black Lotus token.
Activate a Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature it is attached to.
Repeat from step 3.

1267-5406-5409.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Balan does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Medomai the Ageless exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
1267-5406-5409.description:
Declare Balan as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Balan by paying {1}{W}, attaching Dinosaur Headdress to it and causing Balan to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Balan.
Balan triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Repeat each turn.

338-678-2034-2060-2123.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-678-2034-2060-2123.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kokusho, adding {C}{C}.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

337-2211-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real and Captain's Hook attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-2211-4222-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

1349-1999-2793-3088-4050.manaNeeded: {1} the first turn, with {6} available each extra turn
1349-1999-2793-3088-4050.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter and Xenic Poltergeist do not have summoning sickness.
1349-1999-2793-3088-4050.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability triggers, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {U}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing to not put an artifact onto the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

602-2383-3878-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You had an Angel and/or a Berserker enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
602-2383-3878-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Cleaving Reaper, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Faith of the Devoted and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Faith of the Devoted trigger, causing you to pay {1} to cause each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Cleaving Reaper by paying 3 life, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1742-2498-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
1742-2498-4691.description:
Activate Vilis by paying {B} and two life, targeting any creature.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat.

779-3101-3550-4269.description:
Cast Flame Jab from your graveyard by paying {R} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Runaway Steam-Kin and Moonveil Regent trigger.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Moonveil Regent trigger, causing you to discard your hand, mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Flame Jab, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

803-1447-2034.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1261-2608.notablePrerequisites:
Derevi does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block Derevi.
1261-2608.description:
Attack with Derevi.
Derevi triggers upon dealing combat damage, untapping Time Vault.
Tap Time Vault to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.

1507-5109.description:
Activate Glarecaster's ability.
Cast Volcano Hellion, dealing infinite damage to an opponent.
